links.outcome: Self-reported AI knowledge and perceptions before vs after AI education webinar
links.effect: "Very knowledgeable" rose from 4.5% to 25% (p=0.003); disagreement that AI would replace radiologists rose from 43.9% to 87.9%; support for formal AI training increased.
links.quote: Self-reported knowledge improved, with participants identifying as "very knowledgeable" increasing from 4.5% to 25% after the session (p=0.003).
